name: Cricket Hero
author: Addicting Games
description: Cricket Hero is a free sports game. Woah, here we go. We all love sports, the crack of the bat, the swish of the balls, the tension before a goal, and the exuberance after you win. Cricket is a game, it is not just a small annoying creature that sneaks into your apartment and sings for hours on end as you try to live your life like a normal person. The rules of Cricket are actually somewhat similar to the rules of the American classic Baseball. The part of Cricket that is most like baseball is where you as the batter have a bat and stand on a diamond as the opposing team pitches a ball to you. At this point the onus is on you, the hitter, to hit that ball as far and as fast as you can. Your goal is to keep the other team distracted long enough for you and any other players out on the bases to run home. It is a cyclical game with almost no violence. In this hit video game you will be taking on the role of a hardcore cricket hero who is smashing the balls into the stratosphere.
